hero_banner.title: Stranger Things
hero_banner.short_description: A group of friends uncovers supernatural mysteries in the small town of Hawkins.
hero_banner.full_description: When a young boy disappears, his friends discover a mysterious girl, secret government experiments, and a terrifying alternate dimension known as the Upside Down.

items.title: Wednesday
items.short_description: Wednesday Addams investigates a series of mysterious murders at Nevermore Academy.
items.full_description: Wednesday Addams navigates friendships, psychic visions, and supernatural secrets while investigating a dangerous mystery connected to her family's past.

items.title: Squid Game
items.short_description: Hundreds of cash-strapped contestants compete in deadly versions of childhood games.
items.full_description: Desperate for money, contestants accept an invitation to compete in a mysterious series of games. The prize promises financial freedom, but losing comes at a deadly cost.

items.title: The Witcher
items.short_description: A solitary monster hunter navigates a world filled with magic, kingdoms, and dangerous creatures.
items.full_description: Geralt of Rivia, a mutated monster hunter, struggles to find his place in a world where humans can prove more monstrous than the beasts he hunts.

items.title: Money Heist
items.short_description: A criminal mastermind recruits a team for an ambitious heist on Spain's Royal Mint.
items.full_description: A mysterious man known as the Professor brings together a group of skilled criminals to execute an elaborate robbery while negotiating with the police and managing tensions inside the building.

items.title: Dark
items.short_description: A missing child sets four families on a frantic hunt for answers across generations.
items.full_description: When two children go missing in a small German town, its sinful past is exposed along with the double lives and fractured relationships that exist among four families as they search for the kids.

items.title: Peaky Blinders
items.short_description: A notorious gang in 1919 Birmingham is led by the fierce Tommy Shelby.
items.full_description: Britain is a mix of despair and hedonism in 1919 in the aftermath of the Great War. Returning soldiers, newly-minted revolutionaries and criminal gangs all fight for survival in an industrial landscape on the brink of revolution.

items.title: Breaking Bad
items.short_description: A chemistry teacher diagnosed with terminal lung cancer turns to manufacturing methamphetamine.
items.full_description: Walter White, a high school chemistry teacher who learns he has terminal lung cancer, teams up with his former student Jesse Pinkman to produce and distribute crystal meth to secure his family's financial future.

items.title: Superman
items.short_description: An anthology series exploring a twisted, high-tech multiverse where humanity's greatest innovations collide.
items.full_description: Featuring stand-alone dramas about sharp, suspenseful, satirical tales that explore techno-paranoia, Black Mirror is a contemporary British drama television series created by Charlie Brooker.

items.title: Hancock
items.short_description: A chronicled look at the criminal exploits of Colombian drug lord Pablo Escobar.
items.full_description: The gritty, action-packed drama follows the rise and fall of the Medellín cartel and the DEA agents dedicated to bringing them down in a bloody conflict that gripped Colombia and the United States.

items.title: The Matrix
items.short_description: A financial planner relocates his family to the Missouri Ozarks to launder money for a cartel.
items.full_description: Marty Byrde must launder hundreds of millions of dollars after a scheme goes wrong, navigating local criminals, FBI investigations, and treacherous cartel bosses in the misty Ozark mountains.

items.title: Extraction 2
items.short_description: A black-market mercenary returns for another dangerous rescue mission.
items.full_description: Tyler Rake takes on a perilous mission to rescue a ruthless gangster's imprisoned family from a heavily guarded compound, pushing his survival skills to the limit.

items.title: The Night Agent
items.short_description: An FBI agent answers a call that pulls him into a dangerous political conspiracy.
items.full_description: A low-level FBI agent working a secret emergency phone line becomes entangled in a conspiracy that reaches the highest levels of government.

items.title: Lupin
items.short_description: A clever gentleman thief draws inspiration from the legendary Arsène Lupin.
items.full_description: Assane Diop uses disguise, deception, and ingenious schemes to expose a powerful family's crimes and avenge the injustice suffered by his father.

items.title: Our Planet
items.short_description: Explore the world's most remarkable habitats and the wildlife that calls them home.
items.full_description: This nature documentary series travels across the planet, revealing extraordinary wildlife, breathtaking ecosystems, and the impact of environmental change.

items.title: The Crown
items.short_description: A historical drama exploring the reign of Queen Elizabeth II and the events that shaped Britain.
items.full_description: From political rivalries to personal struggles, this historical drama follows the British royal family through decades of changing society and monumental events.

items.title: Planet Earth II
items.short_description: David Attenborough presents a stunning exploration of Earth's islands, mountains, jungles, and deserts.
items.full_description: Experience the world from the viewpoint of animals themselves. Traveling through 40 countries, this series reveals the incredible ways animals overcome challenges to survive in the wild.

items.title: The Queen's Gambit
items.short_description: An orphaned chess prodigy struggles with addiction in a quest to become the greatest chess player.
items.full_description: Orphaned at the tender age of nine, prodigious introvert Beth Harmon discovers and masters the game of chess in 1960s USA. But child stardom comes at a price.

items.title: Chernobyl
items.short_description: The gripping dramatization of the catastrophic 1986 nuclear accident and the heroes who saved Europe.
items.full_description: In April 1986, an explosion at the Chernobyl nuclear power station in the USSR becomes one of the world's worst man-made catastrophes, exposing bureaucratic cowardice and extraordinary human courage.

items.title: Mindhunter
items.short_description: Two FBI agents delve into criminal psychology to solve ongoing serial killer cases.
items.full_description: In the late 1970s, two FBI agents expand criminal science by interviewing imprisoned serial killers to understand how they think and apply that knowledge to unsolved investigations.

items.title: Sherlock
items.short_description: A modern update finds the famous sleuth and his doctor partner solving crime in 21st-century London.
items.full_description: Sherlock Holmes and Dr. John Watson use brilliant forensic reasoning and modern technology to solve perplexing crimes in 21st-century London, facing dangerous adversaries like Jim Moriarty.

items.title: Severance
items.short_description: Employees undergo a surgical procedure to separate their work memories from personal memories.
items.full_description: Mark leads a team of office workers whose memories have been surgically divided between their work and personal lives. When a mysterious colleague appears outside of work, it begins a journey to discover the truth about their jobs.
